newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool - Currency values call the tune.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool - Currency values call the tune.

text.p: Currency factors dominated the market with a strong Australian dollar keeping up the price of imported wool in the main consuming countries.
Market sources also cited the fact that sterling was a little softer again, against the dollar and European currencies.

The effect was to push up prices on tops, with better qualities mostly up two to three pence sterling. Higher quoted prices will not help move wool although some sources cited hopes that exporting to Europe might be less difficult.

New business was quiet but with some opportunities in the home market. Deliveries were going out well with some sectors reasonably placed for activity, if not profits. London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
